title: HumanLayer — Open-Source Multiplayer Coding Agent Workspace & Control Plane
resourceType: Open-source coding-agent collaborative IDE / task control plane / local & remote daemon
purpose: 將 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Pi 等 Coding Agent Sessions、Tasks、Research/Plan Artifacts、程式碼 Diff、PR 與團隊評論集中管理。透過桌面／網頁介面、各主機 Daemon、可選遠端執行、Git Worktrees、多 Repo Workspace 與跨 Session 同步，支援 Research → Plan → Implement（RPI）及人工審查的 Agent 開發流程。
recommendation: 適合多個 Coding Agent、跨人員或跨裝置協作大型程式碼專案，希望清楚管理任務與工作區、審查 Plan／Diff，並可在本機與遠端切換 Session 的團隊。研究時可參考其控制平面、Human-in-the-Loop 與 RPI 技術架構；新手或單一 Agent 的簡單任務不一定需要完整服務堆疊。安裝前須先確認自架需求、模型帳號或 API 成本、權限與資訊安全。
notes: 2026-10-27 checked official HumanLayer open-source announcement (published 2026-10-23), GitHub latest main README/LICENSE/NOTICE/SECURITY and directories, and official docs. The current repository is a Bun/Turborepo monorepo containing web/desktop apps (Electron/Tauri), daemons, humanlayer CLI, oRPC/Hono cloud API, Electric/Postgres sync proxy, Claude Code/OpenCode/Pi plugins, Research-Plan-Implement Claude skills and Linear CLI. Source code released under Apache License 2.0; NOTICE enumerates vendored MIT components. This is distinct from humanlayer/agentcontrolplane (older alpha Kubernetes orchestrator) and humanlayer/12-factor-agents (methodology). Older README/search snippets may describe the old repo as deprecated and marketing pages may still say 'not yet open source'; prioritize 2026-10-23 official announcement and current main. Self-host documentation is still in progress; official README warns Docker Compose starter uses default/simple passwords that must be changed before deployment. Official announcement warns a number of third-party API keys/DSNs are not yet optional and certain processes will not start without them. Source build reportedly sends no vendor telemetry unless env keys are set, but an actual deployment, SaaS use or external agent/model invocation may process sensitive source code and send data to provider services; review security, SSO, integration scopes, credential handling and network policies. Hosted subscriptions and model/provider charges are distinct; confirm current prices with vendor prior to use. News pointer supplied by user (https://www.aiposthub.com/humanlayer-ai-news-20261025/) was not directly retrievable, so only verifiable first-party statements were recorded. No installation, source build, execution, account connection or security test performed. Existing V2 Workflow for spec → multi-agent delivery → evidence QA covers related method; no duplicate Workflow/Skill or Concept created solely for this news.

source.summary: Official announcement dated 2026-10-23; verified repository main README, Apache-2.0 LICENSE, NOTICE and SECURITY on 2026-10-27. HumanLayer and its RPI components were not installed, executed or security-tested.
